svg.aria-label: P7-a: k_thread_priority_set(self, same priority) acts as a yield (CONFIG_USE_SWITCH=y)

g.data-tip: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible), t3 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.
g.title: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible), t3 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): t1 runs. t1 runs its own code in thread mode.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): t1 runs. t1 runs its own code in thread mode.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): requeue t1 (same prio). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). z_impl_k_thread_priority_set(t1, 1) (thread.c:1629) -> z_thread_prio_set() (thread.c:1637, sched.c:596): Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK (kspinlock.h:34) is a k_spin_lock(): BASEPRI is raised (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57) (sched.c:601). t1 is ready: dequeue_thread(), prio = 1, queue_thread() (sched.c:606-608): t1 goes behind each ready thread of the same priority, also when the priority does not change. On one CPU this is also true for _current.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): requeue t1 (same prio). On one CPU this is also true for _current.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): update_cache(1). sched.c:631. update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173). The cooperative test (kthread.h:262-263) does not run.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): update_cache(1). sched.c:631. update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173). The cooperative test (kthread.h:262-263) does not run.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): unlock. The end of Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK in z_thread_prio_set(): k_spin_unlock() writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). An interrupt can come here: its exit switches to the cache (t2) if it differs from _current.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): unlock. The end of Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK in z_thread_prio_set(): k_spin_unlock() writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). An interrupt can come here: its exit switches to the cache (t2) if it differs from _current.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): z_reschedule_unlocked(). thread.c:1641 -> z_reschedule_irqlock(arch_irq_lock()) (ksched.h:157): resched() is true (sched.c:374), need_swap(): cache t2 != _current t1 (sched.c:390-391): z_swap_irqlock() (sched.c:658-659) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:176, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): z_reschedule_unlocked(). thread.c:1641 -> z_reschedule_irqlock(arch_irq_lock()) (ksched.h:157): resched() is true (sched.c:374), need_swap(): cache t2 != _current t1 (sched.c:390-391): z_swap_irqlock() (sched.c:658-659) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:176, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).

g.data-tip: ready_q.cache: t1. _kernel.ready_q.cache: the thread that the next reschedule point selects.
